voice.summary: Tickoff sounds like a friend who keeps your to-do list honest: brisk, kind and tiny on words. It cheers each finished item and treats an empty list as a good day.
dos: Write tasks as short verb phrases
Celebrate completion in a few words

taglines: Today, one tick at a time
boilerplate: Tickoff is a simple daily task list with quick add, priorities, filters and undo, designed for people who want to finish a short list rather than manage a long one.

microcopy.error: Could not save that task. Try again.
microcopy.empty: Nothing on your list. Enjoy the day.

logo.note: A short progress bar echoes ticking items off a list.
